system.description:
Work smart, not hard.

Creation: You can spend a downtime move to work in the laboratory. If you do so roll a d6 and create one of the following consumables with you: (1) Stim Pack (2 HP); (2) Extra Energy (2 Stress); (3) Spare (2 HP for your Spaceship); (4) Electric Shield (+2 Armor Slots for one fight); (5) Lightning in a bottle (2 Hope); (6) Choose one of the options above.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist
